proposal.inferred_root_cause: partial degradation at card:icici inside a medium-severity maintenance window
proposal.reasoning_trace: card:icici has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and Razorpay has a medium-severity downtime open on this issuer, running about 4 minutes. A medium-severity window with attempts still succeeding is degradation rather than an outage, so recovery is worth attempting inside it. Attempt 3 failing the same way weakens the transient reading, which is why confidence is below a first failure. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
